resources.string: A service of ours inside the guest: it keeps the hide list below resolved and receives imported APKs (the “AEmu Import” app in the guest). Applies at the next boot.

A listed app reads the guest as if Magisk were not in it: no su, no module files, unmounted /proc/mounts. Apps that are not listed — the Magisk app above all — always see the full guest. Applies at the next boot.
This image’s package list is not in a readable form, so apps cannot be picked here — type package names instead; the agent resolves them inside the guest.
